recent_notebooks.summary: Scrambling (delocalization of quantum information) does not inherently prevent the formation of objective records. Objectivity is achieved when system pointer states are redundantly encoded into environmental degrees of freedom, a process formalized by Spectrum Broadcast Structures and clarified by the A/R/F framework…

claims.statement: Objective physical records emerge through environmental decoherence, redundantly encoding system pointer states into the environment.

support.explanation: Establishes the foundational link between quantum-to-classical transitions and environmental redundancy.
support.passage: The problem of objectivity, i.e. how to explain on quantum grounds the objective character of the macroscopic world, is one of the aspects of the celebrated quantum-to-classical transition.
